description: Closed-form matched-pair OR (unbelted vs belted) in two-occupant vehicles with one death, under reclassification of a fraction f of belted survivors to unbelted
population: FARS 2016-2024 occupants (driver/passenger) of in-transport light passenger vehicles, seat front-left/front-other/second row, age 13+, belted or unbelted, known outcome; vehicles with exactly 2 eligible occupants and exactly one death
method: Conditional ML for 1:1 matched pairs: OR = n10/n01; expected counts under misreporting n10*(1-f), n01 + f*n00; Poisson CI treating vehicles as independent
